title: Diluted Urgency (Logging Business/Input Validation as ERROR)
pattern: Invoking `log::error!` or `log::severe!` for user input errors, predictable validation failures, or expected business logic dead-ends.
why_bad: Dilutes the meaning of `ERROR` levels, causing SRE/operator alert fatigue. Anything logged as `ERROR` or `SEVERE` should strictly indicate a system-level degradation requiring manual human intervention to resolve [283, 692].
detection: Presence of `error!` level logger calls inside parsing, input validation, or parameter checking routines.
fix: Downgrade user or client-side validation failures to the `warn!` or `info!` logging levels.
